name: Catalyst Capital Management
product: EB-5 Construction Administration and Loan Servicing
description: Catalyst Capital Management provides construction administration and loan servicing for EB-5 fund administrators, regional centers and EB-5 funds.

risks.name: Overfunding
risks.description: Draws that pay for work not yet in place leave investor capital exposed if the project stalls.

risks.name: Scope and Budget Gaps
risks.description: Budget gaps, schedule slips and change orders surface late when no one is reading every draw.

risks.name: Unpaid Trades
risks.description: A general contractor fails to pay subcontractors, resulting in liens against the collateral.

risks.name: Section Q
risks.description: Under the 2022 Reform and Integrity Act, an affiliated JCE must confirm to the fund administrator within 30 days that a construction consultant verified each deployment.

currentMandate: Servicing partner to an EB-5 syndicator on a $32 million mezzanine loan for a mixed-use project, working alongside the fund’s third-party administrator and regional center.
